pages.text: Programs sometimes need a password or a key, e.g. for a web service. c0de keeps them out of sight in three ways:

$(li)INPUT with $(1)PARAMETER hide TRUE ;$() shows $(1)*$() on the laptop while you type.$(li)Variable, constant and literal items can hide their value for good ($(l)Hide the value$() in their dialog).$(li)The tag $(1)security: "sensitive"$() on a variable or constant shows $(1)***$() in the debugging tool.
Hiding protects against people who look at your screen. Real secrets belong into your vault.
